Powered server tick gathers connected movable blocks from each magnetic block on facing ray, at most27 distinct positions, obeying UNMOVEABLE, magnetic/sticky eligibility and removal order. Captures exact BlockState/shape/offset/BlockEntity NBT, removes native blocks and spawns MovingMetal with placementCooldown1. Powered tick both sides scans facing range AABB with NO_SPECTATORS and pulled-or-MovingMetal gate. pushEntity normalizes only length>1, adds force0.2F; MovingMetal uses0.04F, azure range falloff max(f-(distance+1),0)/f where f=max(range-1,1), scarlet distance<=1 zero, and placementCooldown2. FallingBlock sets fall-blocking, halves original velocity and uses0.04F. Living recipients use0.2F and sequential dominant-axis projection, then fallDistance0. Nearby moving metal suppresses the force addition. Range=clamp(5+extenderIngots-retracterIngots,1,64); scarlet returns total+1. Ingot input modifies persisted counts under exact item/shift/creative/admission predicates. No damage/status/attacker attribution exists in this block path.

contracts.actual_behavior: MovingMetal overrides movesEntities and canBeCollidedWith true. Shared moving-block tick carries actors before moving SELF; scans bbox.inflate(0,float0.01,0), NO_SPECTATORS and not same vehicle; skips noPhysics and other MovingMetal. Carries with SHULKER move using float-truncated original displacement; if platform Y>=0 adds recipient native gravity (0 for noGravity, otherwise0.08 or living GRAVITY attribute). No crush damage. Server placement cooldown defaults40, decrements only when canBePlaced; when expired tests all block cells, destroys replaceable blockers with native drops, preserves nonreplaceable refusal. Clearance places captured states and merges captured block NBT, catches load exceptions, then removes KILLED. Failed clearance retries after5+nextInt(10). Every tick velocity*=0.98. Native actual shape union and min/max AABB provide collision; synchronized tag rebuild refreshes data/shape/bbox. Save data persists only BlockDataContainer, not a new progression/owner state.
